chunks: My father, may Allah be pleased with him, said: Sa'd bin Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad bin Muhammad Isa, that he said: Abu Humam Isma'il bin Humam narrated to us from al-Rida (peace be upon him) that he said to a man:

What is tranquility to you? The people did not know what it was, so they said: May Allah make us your ransom, what is it? He said: A good-smelling wind that departs from Paradise which has a shape like the shape of a human and stays with the Prophets (peace be upon them). It is the one that was sent down unto Ibrahim (peace be upon him) when he built the Ka'ba, and it began to take such-and-such, and upon it he built the foundation.
ai.seo_question: What is the nature of Sakinah according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Rida (AS) elucidates the metaphysical nature of *Sakinah* not merely as an abstract feeling, but as a tangible, fragrant wind from Paradise possessing a human-like form (*surah*) that accompanies Prophets. This specific manifestation is linked to the construction of the Kaaba by Ibrahim (AS), highlighting its role as divine assistance and presence during foundational acts of worship. This view aligns with Shia exegetical traditions that distinguish between the general concept of tranquility and the specific angelic or spiritual entity sent to support the Prophets.
